title: Nen Emathramu – Benny Joshua Telugu Christian Lyrics
telugu: నే చూచిన గొప్ప క్రియలు నీ చేతి బహుమానమే
english: Ney chuchina goppa kriyalu nee chethi bahumaaname
ney choochey gana kaaryamulu nee dhaya valane
intro: Nen Emathramu is the latest Telugu Christian song translated from popular Tamil Christian song, Naan Emmathiram released on February 19, 2022. This song was written, tuned and sung by Tamil Christian Gospel Singer, Pastor Benny Joshua and music composed by Stanley Stephen. This song was released on March 11, 2023 through Benny Joshua Ministries YouTube channel.
